antones.note: The /calendar/ widget (Ticket Web/Ticketmaster JS calendar) only renders the current month and does not respond to query-string month params for a static fetch. The real ground truth is the venue's own WordPress 'Upcoming Shows' feed at antonesnightclub.com/, which paginates cleanly via /page/2/, /page/3/, /page/4/ and lists every upcoming show (TM-ticketed and non-TM, e.g. RSVP/Partiful and Fever links) through March 2027. Our first read evidently only captured the /calendar/ widget's default September view and missed everything paginated behind it -- that is the dominant cause of the 'unconfirmed' cluster at this venue, not invented/dead shows from other sources.

emos.note: Single flat chronological list (Next.js/Live Nation site), no pagination needed for the visible window; it stops at Nov 27, 2026 (KevOnStage) with no 'load more' encountered. Our first read's misses here were mostly single-day gaps (Sep25 Enter Shikari, Nov1 Hazlett) sitting between two dates that WERE captured, i.e. spot misses in transcription rather than a truncation artifact -- plus several items that are genuinely the correct show but filed under a co-bill/opener's name (The 4411, Untitld, Vincent Lima) or off by one calendar day from the true venue date.

3ten.calendarUrl: https://www.acllive.com/events/venue/acl-live-at-3ten (3tenaustin.com/events redirects here; acllive.com is the parent ACL Live domain that also runs 3TEN and Moody Theater)
3ten.note: Page paginates via a 'Load More Events' button (JS); a static fetch only returned the first batch, Sep 26 - Nov 27, 2026. One item's own venue page (acllive.com/event/2026-10-03-...paloma-morphy) confirmed a show ON Oct 3 that fell in a date this batch happened to skip. A Dec 2026 / early-2027 item (A Drag Queen Christmas) was checked directly and turned out to be booked at ACL Live at THE MOODY THEATER, not 3TEN -- acllive.com hosts both venues' events under one domain, which is a likely source of venue confusion for secondary listing sites.

continental.calendarUrl: https://continentalclub.com/austin (continentalclub.com's bare 404/homepage/'/calendar' URLs are all wrong -- the real page is /austin, found via a site map)
continental.note: Squarespace month-grid calendar; single fetch returned the complete September 2026 grid (2-3 acts per night, every night). Did not page forward into October since none of our disputed items needed it. This club runs late-night support acts as a second line under the same calendar cell (e.g. 'RestFest 4 ... Dossey @12am') -- a source that names only the late act (e.g. 'DOSSEY') is still ON the venue's own calendar, just nested under the headline event's title.

mohawk.calendarUrl: https://mohawkaustin.com/ (its own /events/ and /shows/ pages are dead ends -- /events/ is the private-rental inquiry form and /shows/ truncates behind a 'show me more' button; the real full feed is the Prekindle widget API it embeds: https://www.prekindle.com/api/events/organizer/531433527670566235)
mohawk.note: The venue's homepage embeds a Prekindle ticketing widget; its backing JSON API returns the complete, unpaginated upcoming schedule (50 shows, Sep 2026 - May 2027) in one call. This is a much better 'venue's own calendar' source than the marketing pages, which don't actually list shows at all.
